path.description: The directory listed, as a directory request records it: ~ expanded, . and .. resolved, symlinks kept.

anyOf.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

parent.description: The directory enclosing it; null at a root.

name.description: The subdirectory's name in the directory browsed.

repository.description: True when it is the root of a git repository: a checkout (it holds .git) or a bare repository.

items.description: A subdirectory of the directory browsed, marked when it is a repository's root.

truncated.description: True when the directory holds more than the 1,000 subdirectories listed.
